ayahs.text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يسٓ
ayahs.translation: O THOU human being!
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa-Seeen
ayahs.sahih: Ya, Seen.

ayahs.text: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
ayahs.translation: Consider this Qur’an full of wisdom:
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-Qur-aanil-Hakeem
ayahs.sahih: By the wise Qur'an.

ayahs.text: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.translation: verily, thou art indeed one of God’s message-bearers,
ayahs.transliteration: Innaka laminal mursaleen
ayahs.sahih: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,

ayahs.text: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: pursuing a straight way
ayahs.transliteration: 'Alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
ayahs.sahih: On a straight path.

ayahs.text: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.translation: by [virtue of] what is being bestowed from on high by the Almighty, the Dispenser of Grace,
ayahs.transliteration: Tanzeelal 'Azeezir Raheem
ayahs.sahih: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

ayahs.text: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
ayahs.translation: [bestowed upon thee] so that thou mayest warn people whose forefathers had not been warned, and who therefore are unaware [of the meaning of right and wrong].
ayahs.transliteration: Litunzira qawmam maaa unzira aabaaa'uhum fahum ghaafiloon
ayahs.sahih: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.

ayahs.text: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the word [of God’s condemnation] is bound to come true against most of them: for they will not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad haqqal qawlu 'alaaa aksarihim fahum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.sahih: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
ayahs.translation: Behold, around their necks We have put shack­les, reaching up to their chins, so that their heads are forced up;
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa ja'alnaa feee a'naaqihim aghlaalan fahiya ilal azqaani fahum muqmahoon
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

ayahs.text: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: and We have set a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and We have enshrouded them in veils so that they cannot see:
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa mim baini aydeehim saddanw-wa min khalfihim saddan fa aghshai naahum fahum laa yubsiroon
ayahs.sahih: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.

ayahs.text: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: thus, it is all one to them whether thou warnest them or dost not warn them: they will not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa sawaaa'un 'alaihim 'a-anzartahum am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.sahih: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

ayahs.text: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: Thou canst [truly] warn only him who is willing to take the reminder to heart, and who stands in awe of the Most Gracious although He is beyond the reach of human perception: unto such, then, give the glad tiding of [God’s] forgiveness and of a most excellent reward!
ayahs.transliteration: Innamaa tunziru manit taba 'az-Zikra wa khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaib, fabashshirhu bimaghfiratinw-wa ajrin kareem
ayahs.sahih: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Verily, We shall indeed bring the dead back to life; and We shall record whatever [deeds] they have sent ahead, and the traces [of good and evil] which they have left behind: for of all things do We take account in a record clear.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa Nahnu nuhyil mawtaa wa naktubu maa qaddamoo wa aasaarahum; wa kulla shai'in ahsainaahu feee Imaamim Mubeen
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

ayahs.text: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: AND SET FORTH unto them a parable - [the story of how] the people of a township [behaved] when [Our] message-bearers came unto them.
ayahs.transliteration: Wadrib lahum masalan Ashaabal Qaryatih; iz jaaa'ahal mursaloon
ayahs.sahih: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

ayahs.text: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We sent unto them two [apostles], and. they gave the lie to both; and so We strengthened [the two] with a third; and thereupon they said: “Behold, we have been sent unto you [by God]!”
ayahs.transliteration: Iz arsalnaaa ilaihimusnaini fakazzaboohumaa fa'azzaznaa bisaalisin faqaalooo innaaa ilaikum mursaloon
ayahs.sahih: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
ayahs.translation: [The others] answered: “You are nothing but mortal men like ourselves; moreover, the Most Gracious has never bestowed aught [of revelation] from on high. You do nothing but lie!”
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo maaa antum illaa basharum mislunaa wa maaa anzalar Rahmaanu min shai'in in antum illaa takziboon
ayahs.sahih: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: Said [the apostles]: “Our Sustainer knows that we have indeed been sent unto you;
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo Rabbunaa ya'lamu innaaa ilaikum lamursaloon
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

ayahs.text: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.translation: but we are not bound to do more than clearly deliver the mes­sage [entrusted to us].”
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa 'alainaaa illal balaaghul mubeen
ayahs.sahih: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

ayahs.text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Said [the others]: “Truly, we augur evil from you! Indeed, if you desist not, we will surely stone you, and grievous suffering is bound to befall you at our hands!”
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo innaa tataiyarnaa bikum la'il-lam tantahoo lanar jumannakum wa la-yamassan nakum minnaa 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
ayahs.translation: [The apostles] replied: “Your destiny, good or evil, is [bound up] with yourselves! [Does it seem evil to you] if you are told to take [the truth] to heart? Nay, but you are people who have wasted their own selves!”
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo taaa'irukum ma'akum; a'in zukkirtum; bal antum qawmum musrifoon
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."

ayahs.text: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.translation: At that, a man came running from the farthest end of the city, [and] exclaimed: “O my people! Follow these message-bearers!
ayahs.transliteration: Wa jaaa'a min aqsal madeenati rajuluny yas'aa qaala yaa qawmit tabi'ul mursaleen
ayahs.sahih: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

ayahs.text: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.translation: Follow those who ask no reward of you, and themselves are rightly guided!
ayahs.transliteration: Ittabi'oo mal-laa yas'alukum ajranw-wa hum muhtadoon
ayahs.sahih: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

ayahs.text: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.translation: “[As for me,] why should I not worship Him who has brought me into being, and to whom you all will be brought back?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa liya laaa a'budul lazee fataranee wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.sahih: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

ayahs.text: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
ayahs.translation: Should I take to worship­ping [other] deities beside Him? [But then,] if the Most Gracious should will that harm befall me, their intercession could not in the least avail me, nor could they save me:
ayahs.transliteration: 'A-attakhizu min dooniheee aalihatan iny-yuridnir Rahmaanu bidurril-laa tughni 'annee shafaa 'atuhum shai 'anw-wa laa yunqizoon
ayahs.sahih: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

ayahs.text: إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.translation: and so, behold, I would have indeed, most obviously, lost myself in error!
ayahs.transliteration: Inneee izal-lafee dalaa-lim-mubeen
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

ayahs.text: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
ayahs.translation: “Verily, [O my people,] in the Sustainer of you all have I come to believe: listen, then, to me!”
ayahs.transliteration: Inneee aamantu bi Rabbikum fasma'oon
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

ayahs.text: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: [And] he was told, “[Thou shalt] enter paradise!” - [whereupon] he exclaimed: “Would that my people knew
ayahs.transliteration: Qeelad khulil Jannnah; qaala yaa laita qawmee ya'lamoon
ayahs.sahih: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

ayahs.text: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
ayahs.translation: how my Sustainer has forgiven me [the sins of my past], and has placed me among the honoured ones!”
ayahs.transliteration: Bimaa ghafara lee Rabbee wa ja'alanee minal mukrameen
ayahs.sahih: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

ayahs.text: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.translation: And after that, no host out of heaven did We send down against his people, nor did We need to send down any:
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas-samaaa'i wa maa kunnaa munzileen
ayahs.sahih: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

ayahs.text: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
ayahs.translation: nothing was [needed] but one single blast [of Our punishment] - and lo! they became as still and silent as ashes.
ayahs.transliteration: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum khaamidoon
ayahs.sahih: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.

ayahs.text: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.translation: OH, THE REGRETS that [most] human beings will have to bear! Never has an apostle come to them without their deriding him!
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa hasratan 'alal 'ibaad; maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi 'oon
ayahs.sahih: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

ayahs.text: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.translation: Are they not aware of how many a generation We have destroyed before their time, [and] that those [that have perished] will never return to them,
ayahs.transliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlak naa qablahum minal qurooni annahum ilaihim laa yarji'oon
ayahs.sahih: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?

ayahs.text: وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: and [that] all of them, all together, will [in the end] before Us be arraigned?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa in kullul lammaa jamee'ul-ladainaa muhdaroon
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

ayahs.text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.translation: And [yet,] they have a sign [of Our power to create and to resurrect] in the lifeless earth which We make alive, and out of which We bring forth grain, whereof they may eat;
ayahs.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaahaa wa akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu yaakuloon
ayahs.sahih: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

ayahs.text: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
ayahs.translation: and [how] We make gardens of date-palms and vines [grow] thereon, and cause springs to gush [forth] within it,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naabinw wa fajjarnaa feeha minal 'uyoon
ayahs.sahih: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

ayahs.text: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.translation: so that they may eat of the fruit thereof, though it was not their hands that made it. Will they not, then, be grateful?
ayahs.transliteration: Liyaakuloo min samarihee wa maa 'amilat-hu aideehim; afalaa yashkuroon
ayahs.sahih: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?

ayahs.text: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Limitless in His glory is He who has created opposites in whatever the earth produces, and in men’s own selves, and in that of which [as yet] they have no knowledge.
ayahs.transliteration: Subhaanal lazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.sahih: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

ayahs.text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: And [of Our sway over all that exists] they have a sign in the night: We withdraw from it the [light of] day - and lo! they are in darkness.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahumul lailu naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-izaa hum muzlimoon
ayahs.sahih: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.

ayahs.text: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
ayahs.translation: And [they have a sign in] the sun: it runs in an orbit of its own [and] that is laid down by the will of the Almighty, the All-Knowing;
ayahs.transliteration: Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil Aleem
ayahs.sahih: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

ayahs.text: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
ayahs.translation: and [in] the moon, for which We have determined phases [which it must traverse] till it becomes like an old date-stalk, dried-up and curved:
ayahs.transliteration: Walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur joonil qadeem
ayahs.sahih: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

ayahs.text: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
ayahs.translation: [and] neither may the sun overtake the moon, nor can the night usurp the time of day, since all of them float through space [in accordance with Our laws].
ayahs.transliteration: Lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara wa lal lailu saabiqun nahaar; wa kullun fee falaki yasbahoon
ayahs.sahih: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

ayahs.text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
ayahs.translation: And [it ought to be] a sign for them that We bear their offspring [over the seas] in laden ships,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon
ayahs.sahih: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.

ayahs.text: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
ayahs.translation: and [that] We create for them things of a similar kind, on which they may embark [in their travels];
ayahs.transliteration: Wa khalaqnaa lahum mim-mislihee maa yarkaboon
ayahs.sahih: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

ayahs.text: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
ayahs.translation: and [that,] if such be Our will, We may cause them to drown, with none to respond to their cry for help: and [then] they cannot be saved,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqazoon
ayahs.sahih: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

ayahs.text: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.translation: unless it be by an act of mercy from Us and a grant of life for a [further span of] time.
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa rahmatam minnaa wa mataa'an ilaa heen
ayahs.sahih: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

ayahs.text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: And [yet,] when they are told, “Beware of [God’s insight into] all that lies open before you and all that is hidden from you, so that you might be graced with His mercy,” [most men choose to remain deaf;]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahumuttaqoo maa baina aideekum wa maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon
ayahs.sahih: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "

ayahs.text: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.translation: and no message of their Sustainer s messages ever reaches them without their turning away from it.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa taateehim min aayatim min ayataati Rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen
ayahs.sahih: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

ayahs.text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Thus, when they are told, “Spend on others out of what God has provided for you as sus­tenance,” those who are bent on denying the truth say unto those who believe, “Shall we feed anyone whom, if [your] God had so willed, He could have fed [Himself]? Clearly, you are but lost in error!”
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo anut'imu mal-law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

ayahs.text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translation: And they add, “When is this promise [of resurrection] to be fulfilled? [Answer this] if you are men of truth!”
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.sahih: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.text: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
ayahs.translation: [And they are unaware that] nothing awaits them beyond a single blast [of God’s punishment], which will overtake them while they are still arguing - [against resurrection]:
ayahs.transliteration: Maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan taa khuzuhum wa hum yakhissimoon
ayahs.sahih: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.

ayahs.text: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.translation: and so [sudden will be their end that] no testament will they be able to make, - nor to their own people will they return!
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa yastatee'oona taw siyatanw-wa laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon
ayahs.sahih: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

ayahs.text: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
ayahs.translation: And [then] the trumpet [of resurrection] will be blown - and lo! out of their graves towards their Sustainer will they all rush forth!
ayahs.transliteration: Wa nufikha fis-soori faizaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa Rabbihim yansiloon
ayahs.sahih: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: They will say: “Oh, woe unto us! Who has roused us from our sleep [of death]?” [Whereupon they will be told:] “This is what the Most Gracious has promised! And His message-bearers spoke the truth!”
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo yaa wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haaza maa wa'adar Rahmanu wa sadaqal mursaloon
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

ayahs.text: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Nothing will there have been but one single blast - and lo! before Us will all of them be arraigned [and be told]:
ayahs.transliteration: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon
ayahs.sahih: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

ayahs.text: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: “Today, then, no human being shall be wronged in the least, nor shalt you be requited for aught but what you were doing [on earth].
ayahs.transliteration: Fal-Yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.sahih: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ
ayahs.translation: “Behold, those who are destined for paradise shall today have joy in whatever they do:
ayahs.transliteration: Inna Ashaabal jannatil Yawma fee shughulin faakihoon
ayahs.sahih: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

ayahs.text: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.translation: in happiness will they and their spouses on couches recline;
ayahs.transliteration: Hum wa azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon
ayahs.sahih: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

ayahs.text: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.translation: [only] delight will there be for them, and theirs shall be all that they could ask for:
ayahs.transliteration: Lahum feehaa faakiha tunw-wa lahum maa yadda'oon
ayahs.sahih: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

ayahs.text: سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: peace and fulfillment through the word of a Sustainer who dispenses all grace.
ayahs.transliteration: Salaamun qawlam mir Rabbir Raheem
ayahs.sahih: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

ayahs.text: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: “But stand aside today, O you who were lost in sin!
ayahs.transliteration: Wamtaazul Yawma ayyuhal mujrimoon
ayahs.sahih: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.

ayahs.text: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Did I not enjoin on you, O you children of Adam, that you should not worship Satan – since, verily, he is your open foe
ayahs.transliteration: Alam a'had ilaikum yaa Baneee Aadama al-laa ta'budush Shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
ayahs.sahih: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

ayahs.text: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.translation: and that you should worship Me [alone]? This would have been a straight way!
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ani'budoonee; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.sahih: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.translation: And [as for Satan -] he had already led astray a great many of you: could you not, then, use your reason?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon
ayahs.sahih: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

ayahs.text: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translation: “This, then, is the hell of which you were warned again and again:
ayahs.transliteration: Haazihee Jahannamul latee kuntum too'adoon
ayahs.sahih: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

ayahs.text: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
ayahs.translation: endure it today as an outcome of your persistent denial of the truth!”
ayahs.transliteration: Islawhal Yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon
ayahs.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."

ayahs.text: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.translation: On that Day We shall set a seal on their mouths but their hands will speak unto Us, and their feet will bear witness to whatever they have earned [in life].
ayahs.transliteration: Al-Yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim wa tukallimunaaa aideehim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.sahih: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

ayahs.text: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: NOW HAD IT BEEN Our will [that men should not be able to discern between right and wrong], We could surely have deprived them of their sight, so that they would stray forever from the [right] way: for how could they have had insight [into what is true]?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa law nashaaa'u lata masna 'alaaa aiyunihim fasta baqus-siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon
ayahs.sahih: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?

ayahs.text: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.translation: And had it been Our will [that they should not be free to choose between right and wrong], We could surely have given them a different nature [and created them as beings rooted] in their places, so that they would not be able to move forward, and could not turn back.]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas-tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon
ayahs.sahih: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.

ayahs.text: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.translation: But [let them always remember that] if We lengthen a human being’s days, We also cause him to decline in his powers [when he grows old]: will they not, then, use their reason?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa man nu 'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon
ayahs.sahih: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?

ayahs.text: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.translation: AND [thus it is:] We have not imparted to this [Prophet the gift of] poetry, nor would [poetry] have suited this [message]: it is but a reminder and a [divine] discourse, clear in itself and clearly showing the truth,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra wa maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa zikrunw-wa Qur-aanum mubeen
ayahs.sahih: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an

ayahs.text: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.translation: to the end that it may warn everyone who is alive [of heart], and that the word [of God] may bear witness against all who deny the truth.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyunzira man kaana haiyanw-wa yahiqqal qawlu 'alal-kaafireen
ayahs.sahih: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.

ayahs.text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
ayahs.translation: Are they, then, not aware that it is for them that We have created, among all the things which Our hands have wrought, the domestic animals of which they are [now] masters? –
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon
ayahs.sahih: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?

ayahs.text: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.translation: and that We have subjected them to men’s will, so that some of them they may use for riding and of some they may eat,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa zallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum wa minhaa yaakuloon
ayahs.sahih: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

ayahs.text: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.translation: and may have [yet other] benefits from them, and [milk] to drink? Will they not, then, be grateful? (
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lahum feehaa manaa fi'u wa mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon
ayahs.sahih: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

ayahs.text: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: But [nay,] they take to worshipping deities other than God, [hoping] to be succoured [by them, and not knowing that]
ayahs.transliteration: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon
ayahs.sahih: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

ayahs.text: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: they are unable to succour their devotees, even though to them they may [appear to] be hosts drawn up [for succour].
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wa hum lahum jundum muhdaroon
ayahs.sahih: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.

ayahs.text: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: However, be not grieved by the sayings of those [who deny the truth]: verily, We know all that they keep secret as well as all that they bring into the open.
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon
ayahs.sahih: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

ayahs.text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.translation: IS MAN, then, not aware that it is We who create him out of a [mere] drop of sperm - whereupon, lo! he shows himself endowed with the power to think and to argue?
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen
ayahs.sahih: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?

ayahs.text: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And [now] he [argues about Us, and] thinks of Us in terms of comparison, and is oblivious of how he himself was created! [And so] he says, “Who could give life to bones that have crumbled to dust?”
ayahs.transliteration: Wa daraba lanaa maslanw-wa nasiya khalqahoo qaala mai-yuhyil'izaama wa hiya rameem
ayahs.sahih: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

ayahs.text: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.translation: Say: “He who brought them into being in the first instance will give them life [once again], seeing that He has full knowledge of every act of creation:
ayahs.transliteration: Qul yuh yeehal lazeee ansha ahaaa awwala marrah; wa Huwa bikulli khalqin 'Aleem
ayahs.sahih: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
ayahs.translation: He who produces for you fire out of the green tree, so that, lo! you kindle [your fires] therewith.”
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-izaaa antum minhu tooqidoon
ayahs.sahih: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

ayahs.text: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.translation: Is, then, He who has created the heavens and the earth not able to create [anew] the like of those [who have died]? Yea, indeed - for He alone is the all-knowing Crea­tor:
ayahs.transliteration: Awa laisal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa wa Huwal Khallaaqul 'Aleem
ayahs.sahih: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

ayahs.text: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.translation: His Being alone is such that when He wills a thing to be, He but says unto it, “Be” — and it is.
ayahs.transliteration: Innamaa amruhooo izaaa araada shai'an ai-yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon
ayahs.sahih: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

ayahs.text: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.translation: Limitless, then, in His glory is He in whose hand rests the mighty dominion over all things; and unto Him you all will be brought back!
ayahs.transliteration: Fa Subhaanal lazee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw-wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.sahih: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
